title: Semantic-enhanced heterogeneous graph learning for identifying ncRNAs associated with drug resistance
purpose: Inspect original architecture and annotate the replacement scope of the current TabICLv2 pipeline.
annotation_note: Red boxes and Chinese explanatory text were added to the original figure. The current pipeline uses fixed graph/evidence pair features and frozen TabICLv2 instead of the published GeneralConv encoder and concat/MLP edge decoder. The right-hand block of Figure 1(b) is an expansion of the same encoder.
